Name: Simple Jump - Multiplayer friendly
Author: TheAcaciaBoat
Description:
Simple Jump adds variable-height jumps on foot and on horseback. You can adjust the minimum and maximum height, hold time and gravity, and choose whether jumping lets you cross small objects.

Press Space to jump. Tap for a short jump, or hold the button to jump higher.
 
[b]Install[/b]
[list]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.5.2 or newer.[/*]
[*]Unzip the SimpleJump folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]Built for Stardew Valley 1.6.15. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] 1.14.1 or newer is optional, but recommended for changing settings in-game.

[b]Use[/b]
Space is the default jump button. Release it early for a lower jump, or hold it until the configured hold time to reach the maximum height. You can move while airborne. Release and press again after landing to start another jump.

With object jumping enabled, you can cross small one-tile objects such as sprinklers and mine rocks, provided you are above them at the moment you pass. Walls, water, trees, fences, furniture, large rocks and large machines keep their normal collisions.

If you land on an object, the mod moves you smoothly back along your path to a clear landing point. This plays the game's hurt sound without dealing damage.

[b]Settings[/b]
Open Generic Mod Config Menu and select Simple Jump. You can change:
[list]
[*]Jump button, including controller buttons.[/*]
[*]Minimum and maximum jump height.[/*]
[*]Maximum hold time and gravity.[/*]
[*]Jumping over small objects.[/*]
[*]Horse jumping.[/*]
[*]Landing bounce, jump animation and sounds.[/*]
[/list]Turning off jump animation keeps the normal walking cycle in the air. The landing bounce only applies to jumps above 64 pixels. Gravity stays the same at every jump height.

[b]Multiplayer and compatibility[/b]
Jump synchronization is included. Everyone should install the same version of Simple Jump to see the jumps, held items and horses correctly. Each player can choose their own settings.

[b]Support[/b]
For help or bug reports, join [url=https://discord.gg/eZC767Kcyj]the Discord server[/url]. Include your mod version and a [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log link[/url] when reporting a problem.
